# Geokeo

Geokeo provides geocoding services, converting addresses to coordinates and vice versa, with a free tier offering 2,500 daily API requests.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/geokeo/.

## Actions

- **Forward Geocoding** (read-only): Perform forward geocoding lookup by address or place name.
- **Reverse Geocoding Lookup** (read-only): Perform reverse geocoding.
